digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback chain tracing and observability
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one rebar OTel span with zero-based order and provider-qualified model identity, parented to the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context, without duplication from instrument_all.

A candidate span carries an outcome drawn from {`returned`,`raised`} — the answering model `returned`, each earlier failed candidate `raised` — and optionally records provider-reported usage when the SDK response exposes it.
A raised-outcome span reason is redacted through sanitize_diagnostic under the message key to exclude prompt, response, credential, endpoint, or unsanitized body content.

The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup resolution and S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade remain unchanged; both native and prompted agent.run route through the same wrapped candidates and are legible as native-span raised then prompted-span returned.

Span-emission or exporter failure while tracing is enabled leaves the fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off because instrumentation errors are swallowed at the wrapper boundary.
The base install without tracing extra imports runs with no span dependency error, and RunUsage and usage JSONL are identical with tracing on and off and contain no candidate counter.
